description: Direct pytest sessions on GitHub's hosted Ubuntu runners, including Android JNI and Windows cross-builds. Native reports separately identify their execution target. Only the exact Windows runtime-only cases below may skip; Android JNI admits no skips. This does not claim podman execution or physical Linux desktop qualification.

rules.reason: ^requires Windows: windows\.yml's win32-native job runs the executables the build tests publish$
rules.note: windows.yml win32-native-build publishes the executables; win32-native executes these same nodes on windows-x64 and windows-arm64 and enforces each native skip report. Missing build prerequisites and other nodes remain unexpected. The GUI conformance suite's Windows rows are built and run the same way.

rules.note: docs/design/native-ui-surfaces-and-hosts.md: the suite's macOS rows build its AppKit probe and run on a macOS display; both frontends and sanitizer modes run on the named stand-in.
